description: This file implements RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) authorization logic for Kubernetes, defining the RBAC authorizer, rule resolution, and related interfaces and classes.

classes.name: RBACAuthorizer
classes.description: Implements the authorizer.Authorizer interface using RBAC policies.

classes.name: authorizingVisitor
classes.description: Helper class to short-circuit authorization checks once allowed and collect errors.

classes.name: RoleGetter
classes.description: Wrapper for RoleLister to get roles.

classes.name: RoleBindingLister
classes.description: Wrapper for RoleBindingLister to list role bindings.

classes.name: ClusterRoleGetter
classes.description: Wrapper for ClusterRoleLister to get cluster roles.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBindingLister
classes.description: Wrapper for ClusterRoleBindingLister to list cluster role bindings.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Checks if a rule allows the request; short-circuits if allowed.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Performs authorization decision based on RBAC rules.

methods.name: RulesFor
methods.description: Returns resource and non-resource rules applicable to a user in a namespace.

methods.name: GetRole
methods.description: Retrieves a Role by name and namespace.

methods.name: ListRoleBindings
methods.description: Lists role bindings in a namespace.
